analysis.title: UBS US Mid Term Elections Liquidity Predictions
key_insights: UBS Futures Execution desk compared volume, volatility, top-of-book size and average spread in the equivalent days of the 2022 midterm cycle and projected 2026 liquidity for the November 3 election.

Method: a baseline for each liquidity metric (daily volume, bid-ask spread, top-of-book size, daily volatility) is set from the 15 trading days before the event. The relative change seen on and after the event date in past occurrences is then applied to the current baseline.
Post-election liquidity may peak on Thursday November 5 across much of the financial futures complex, including Treasuries, Bunds and FX futures.
Energy futures activity may peak on Election Day itself (November 3) rather than on November 5.
Volatility in Treasuries, Bunds, energy and equity index futures could peak on November 5, based on 2022 trends.
Volatility in FX, precious metals and short-term rates could peak on November 10, based on 2022 trends.
UBS says the execution window may extend into the days after the election rather than being concentrated on November 3.
The predictions are adjusted to 2026 daily average metrics between 08:00 and 17:00 EST and are based on a single prior cycle (2022). UBS notes past liquidity is not indicative of future results.
risk_factors: Projections rely on 2022 midterm patterns and may not repeat. UBS states actual liquidity conditions may differ from the predictions.
Volatility in FX, precious metals and short-term rates may stay elevated through November 10, which could extend execution difficulty beyond Election Day.
vol_and_positioning: Volatility in Treasuries, Bunds, energy and equity index futures could peak on November 5, based on 2022 trends.
Volatility in FX, precious metals and short-term rates could peak on November 10, based on 2022 trends.
Liquidity (volume, top-of-book size, spread) across Treasury, Bund and FX futures may peak on November 5, with energy futures liquidity peaking on Election Day.
geopolitical: US midterm elections on November 3, 2026 and the expected effect on futures market liquidity and volatility.
